name: Home Assistant (MQTT)
author: NetMaster
description: Sends security alerts (with a fixed type per alert, ready for automations), the number of unknown devices, and the devices you pick (presence, IP, MAC, top sites and an Internet pause switch) to Home Assistant through your MQTT broker. Home Assistant finds everything by itself (MQTT discovery).

settings.label: MQTT broker address
settings.help: The IP or name of your broker, for example the Home Assistant computer when you use the Mosquitto add-on.

settings.label: Home Assistant discovery prefix
settings.help: Only change this if you changed it in Home Assistant.

settings.label: Topic prefix
settings.help: Where NetMaster publishes its own topics.
